## About this site

This site documents the technical work of the IMBUS project, with a focus on Work Package 2 (Data Standardisation). It covers the DATRAS exchange data format, known data quality issues, the CPUE derivation pipeline, and the data products produced for IMBUS deliverables. It is a living document updated throughout the project.

---

## The `{obus}` R package

The technical implementation of WP2 is the R package **[{obus}](https://github.com/einarhjorleifsson/obus)**
([documentation](https://einarhjorleifsson.github.io/obus/)). `{obus}` is the software layer that
makes the IMBUS data products accessible to end users.

`{obus}` provides:

- **Lazy DuckDB access** to DATRAS exchange data (HH, HL, CA) stored as Parquet files on a public server, with no download or local storage required.
- **Pre-computed standardised products** — in particular `dr_con("HL_standardised")`, the core IMBUS D2.3 deliverable: a validated, species-resolved, length-frequency table covering all 29 DATRAS surveys.
- **Downstream helpers** (`dr_catch_by_haul()`, `dr_expand_length()`) for zero-filling and swept-area calculations.

The Parquet files served by `{obus}` are the IMBUS D2.3 integrated data product. The package, the parquet server, and this documentation site together constitute the WP2 technical output.

```r
# Install
remotes::install_github("einarhjorleifsson/obus")

# Example: Atlantic cod length-frequency across all surveys
library(obus)
cod <- dr_con("HL_standardised") |>
  filter(type == "length", latin == "Gadus morhua") |>
  collect()
```

## Work Package 2

WP2 (User requirements, data formats and meta-data) is led by Einar Hjörleifsson (MRI Iceland,
subcontracted to DTU Aqua) and runs M1–M12 (Sep 2025 – Aug 2026).

| Deliverable | Description | Due | Status |
|-------------|-------------|-----|--------|
| D2.1 | User requirements document | M6 (Feb 2026) | ✅ Submitted |
| [D2.2](deliverables/D2.2_data_formats_metadata.qmd) | Data formats and meta-data | M11 (Jul 2026) | 🔶 Draft |
| [D2.3](deliverables/D2.3_imbus_product_specification.qmd) | Integrated data product (R package + Parquet) | M12 (Aug 2026) | 🔶 In progress |
| D2.4 | Data product on ICES web portal | M12 (Aug 2026) | 🔴 Pending |

WP2 outputs feed directly into WP5 (stock assessment) — see the [WP2–WP5 meeting notes](meetings/20260601_WP2-WP5.qmd) for current coordination status.
